# mARC: Multi-Agent Relay Control

> mARC (Multi-Agent Relay Control) is an open-source plugin and self-marketplace that packages a portable, cross-repository AI engineering team into developer terminals (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, and GitHub Copilot CLI).

## Overview
- **Engineering Director:** `/marc:eng-director` coordinates several techlead sessions in one or multiple repositories. It reads queues, routes dependencies and owner decisions, reports evidence, and guides authorized recovery, watcher reconciliation and shared resource use. Leadership skills run in sessions; monitoring and wake-up require local adapters. Private environment bindings stay in the coordination workspace.
- **Channel Operator / Router:** `@techlead` (channel operator invoked with `/marc:tech-lead`).
- **Specialist Pool:** `@dev` (engineering), `@sre` (reliability & infrastructure), `@design` (front-end & UX), `@sec` (security audit gate), `@rev` (correctness review gate), `@research` (external technical evidence & citations), and `@arch` (architecture advice).
- **Supported Harnesses:** Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, and GitHub Copilot CLI, automatically detected by `npx @nexaduo/marc install` (or select with `--harness <claude|copilot|codex|agy>`). See https://github.com/NexaDuo/mARC/blob/main/docs/harnesses.md#openai-codex for Codex compatibility limits.
- **GitHub Project Board Integration:** Tasks map to issues and the consuming project’s own status meanings on GitHub Project boards using runtime `gh` CLI discovery (zero hardcoded stack config).

## Operating Principles
1. **Stateless dispatch & context hygiene:** Specialists run fresh per task; durable state lives in git and the project board.
2. **Pre-merge security & correctness gates:** Mandatory independent dual-pass by `@sec` and `@rev` before any PR merges (no self-merge).
3. **Peer operator coordination:** Multiple concurrent operators on the same repository coordinate via issue claim markers (`## marc:techlead claim`), `git worktree list --porcelain`, and dead-worktree detection.
4. **Two-tier memory model:** Local session memory bounded with permanent invariants (`[PINNED]`) and time-bound decay (`[EXPIRES: YYYY-MM-DD]`). Oversized briefs spill into PR-gated documentation artifacts (`docs/marc/`).

## Installation Quick Reference

Requires Node.js 20+ and harness CLIs on PATH; Antigravity's [CLI installer](https://antigravity.google/cli/) is a prerequisite.

```bash
npx @nexaduo/marc install
npx @nexaduo/marc update
npx @nexaduo/marc doctor
npx @nexaduo/marc uninstall
```

The launcher runs native plugin CLIs and never writes configuration itself.
Use repeatable `--harness <claude|copilot|codex|agy>`, Claude-only `--scope <user|project|local>`, `--dry-run` to preview, and `--yes` for non-interactive mutations.
After installation, invoke `/marc:tech-lead` in your harness. For declarative per-repo Claude team installation, see https://github.com/NexaDuo/mARC/blob/main/docs/install.md#declarative-per-repo-install-claude-code

## Coordinate Several Teams

After installing mARC, open a separate session in your coordination workspace and invoke `/marc:eng-director`. Identify the teams, queues, checkpoints and delegated operations. Each techlead retains task ownership and review gates. The workspace need not be a Git repository.
